title: Whybook
description: Settings of Whybook, a question-driven view of Jupyter notebooks.

interaction.title: How to ask
interaction.description: How you pick what a question is about: drag a variable or a column onto a cell or onto another variable, or click one and then the other.

oneOf.title: Drag
oneOf.description: Drop it on a cell to see the questions

oneOf.title: Click
oneOf.description: Click one, then the other, or use the keys

variablesPlacement.title: Variables, Contents and Questions
variablesPlacement.description: Where the Variables, Contents and Questions panels show.

oneOf.title: Side panel
oneOf.description: In JupyterLab's left side panel

oneOf.title: In Whybook
oneOf.description: A column beside the notebook

explorationPlacement.title: Exploration and Cell details
explorationPlacement.description: Where the Exploration and Cell details panels show.

oneOf.title: Side panel
oneOf.description: In JupyterLab's right side panel

oneOf.title: In Whybook
oneOf.description: A column beside the notebook

exploredOrder.title: Order of Variables explored
exploredOrder.description: The order of the rows of Variables explored, in the Exploration panel. A right click on the head of the list changes it too.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: The most used first, then the largest

oneOf.title: Most used
oneOf.description: Used by the most cells first

oneOf.title: Largest
oneOf.description: The biggest tables first

oneOf.title: By name
oneOf.description: From A to Z

subshellCapacity.title: Parallel runs
subshellCapacity.description: How many branches can run at the same time, the notebook's own run included. They share the kernel's data without a copy.

mapColumns.title: Columns of a data node on the map
mapColumns.description: Where the columns of a data node show when you click the node on the map.

oneOf.title: In Contents
oneOf.description: In the Contents panel, beside its questions

oneOf.title: In the questions
oneOf.description: In the questions, with a filter

outputDetail.title: Level of detail of outputs
outputDetail.description: How much of each output the bench shows. The Detail slider in the toolbar changes it too.

oneOf.title: Overview
oneOf.description: Each table and text as a tile

oneOf.title: Compact
oneOf.description: Tables scaled down, short texts

oneOf.title: Full
oneOf.description: Small tables in full, large plots

mapDetail.title: Outputs on the map
mapDetail.description: How much of each cell's outputs the map shows. The Detail slider in the toolbar changes it while the map shows.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: The cells alone

oneOf.title: Minimal
oneOf.description: One line of small tiles under each cell

oneOf.title: Overview
oneOf.description: Tiles and thumbnails, as on the bench

mapOutputs.title: Outputs on the map (replaced)
mapOutputs.description: Replaced by mapDetail. false still reads as none.

minimap.title: Minimap
minimap.description: A small map of the notebook's sections and cells in a corner of the bench, which opens the map view. It floats over the cards, and a wide bench keeps a column for it.

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: The bench shows only the cards

oneOf.title: On
oneOf.description: The sections and cells in a corner

detailFollowsSpace.title: Level of detail follows the space
detailFollowsSpace.description: A trial: the level of detail grows with the width of the column of cells, and on the map with the zoom. A level you pick on the Detail slider holds until the space calls for another one.

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: The Detail slider sets the level

oneOf.title: On
oneOf.description: More room shows more detail

guessFirst.title: A guess before a result
guessFirst.description: While a cell answers a question about a relation or an effect, offer one click to say what you expect. Guessing first helps you notice a surprise.

oneOf.title: Off
oneOf.description: The cell runs, and asks nothing

oneOf.title: On
oneOf.description: Higher, lower, no difference or not sure

offeredQuestions.title: Offered questions per request
offeredQuestions.description: How many questions a drop or a click offers, best first. None: you type every question yourself.

resultStrips.title: Result strips
resultStrips.description: When the strip with Undo under a changed cell closes: after you move on to another cell, or only when you close it. A strip of a failed answer stays until you close it.

answers.title: Answers that need AI
answers.description: How the remote model answers a question that needs AI: as an agent that adds and runs the cells it needs, or with one cell.

oneOf.title: Agent
oneOf.description: Adds and runs cells, then answers

oneOf.title: One cell
oneOf.description: Writes one cell

agentView.title: Where an agent's run shows
agentView.description: Where the steps of an agent's run show while it works.

oneOf.title: Strip
oneOf.description: Above the cells that the run adds

oneOf.title: Card
oneOf.description: A card of its own on the bench

oneOf.title: Side panel
oneOf.description: In JupyterLab's right side panel

showCost.title: Cost of AI answers
showCost.description: Show what the AI answers of a notebook cost, and set a cap for the notebook. Answers from a model with no known price are not counted.

keepDataLocal.title: Keep data on this machine
keepDataLocal.description: Only models on this machine read outputs and variables, so no values, tables or pictures leave the machine. Labels and captions then need a local model, and pictures cannot be asked about.

zeroDataRetention.title: Zero data retention (OpenRouter)
zeroDataRetention.description: Requests through OpenRouter go only to providers that keep neither the prompt nor the answer. A model with no such provider cannot answer.

models.title: AI models by task
models.description: Which model does each task: the model you connected or a faster one of its provider, a local model, or none. A remote model gets the data that a task needs, unless it runs on this machine.

questions.title: More questions
questions.description: remote, a faster model of the connected provider such as remote:fast, remote:fastest or remote:openrouter:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, off, a local model such as gemma-4-e2b, or custom: and the name of a custom local model in lower case, with dashes for other characters

labels.title: Labels and captions
labels.description: remote, a faster model of the connected provider such as remote:fast, remote:fastest or remote:openrouter:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, off, a local model such as gemma-4-e2b, or custom: and the name of a custom local model in lower case, with dashes for other characters

tableLabels.title: Table labels (replaced by labels)
tableLabels.description: Read only when labels is not set.

typed.title: Typed questions
typed.description: rules, jev, a local model such as gemma-4-e2b, or custom: and the name of a custom local model in lower case, with dashes for other characters

ranking.title: Question order
ranking.description: rules, remote, a faster model of the connected provider such as remote:fast, jev, a local model such as gemma-4-e2b, or custom: and the name of a custom local model in lower case, with dashes for other characters

modelQuestions.title: Questions from a model
modelQuestions.description: When a drop or a click also asks the AI model of More questions for questions, beside those of the templates. None of its questions runs until you pick it.

oneOf.title: Always, with the questions of the templates
Never: only More questions from AI

aiWhenNoTemplate.title: Questions from AI when no template fits (replaced)
aiWhenNoTemplate.description: Replaced by modelQuestions. false still reads as never.

findDefaults.title: Find more defaults with AI
findDefaults.description: When a cell runs, the AI model of More questions reads each library function that the cell calls and that it has not read before. The defaults that can change the result then show as chips on the cell.

localJsonCheck.title: JSON check of local models
localJsonCheck.description: How a local model's answer is held to its JSON rules. Fast gives the same answers sooner, and when it fails the server uses Standard and shows a warning.

customLocalModels.title: Custom local models
customLocalModels.description: GGUF models that the Jupyter server runs with llama.cpp, offered after its own local models. Give each a name, and a Hugging Face repository and file, or the path of a file on the server's machine.

name.description: The name in the selects, such as "Llama 3.2 3B".

repo.description: A Hugging Face repository, such as ggml-org/gemma-4-E2B-it-GGUF.

file.description: The GGUF file in the repository, such as gemma-4-E2B-it-Q4_0.gguf.

revision.description: A commit or a branch of the repository; the latest when left out.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file: a download whose file differs is deleted.

path.description: The absolute path of a GGUF file on the server's machine, in place of a repository and a file.

note.description: What the choice means, under the select.
